title: Production web server unresponsive
description: Customers report intermittent 502 errors on checkout.example.com starting around 09:14 UTC. Load balancer health checks are failing for 2 of 4 backend nodes.

title: User unable to reset VPN password
description: The self-service password reset portal returns a 500 error when the user submits a reset request. Affects a single user account.

title: Billing API returning stale exchange rates
description: Invoices generated after 02:00 UTC show currency conversions using rates from the previous day. Suspect the FX rate cache job failed to run.

title: Internal wiki search returns no results
description: Search bar on the internal wiki returns an empty result set for every query, including terms known to exist on published pages.

title: Outbound email delayed by up to 40 minutes
description: Transactional emails (password resets, receipts) are being queued but not delivered promptly. Gateway logs show repeated connection timeouts to the downstream relay.

title: Nightly backup job failed for db-cluster-02
description: The 01:00 UTC backup job for db-cluster-02 exited with a disk-space error. No successful backup exists for the last 26 hours.

title: Checkout page CSS not loading for some users
description: A subset of users on older mobile browsers report an unstyled checkout page. Suspect a CDN cache-busting issue after the latest deploy.

title: HR portal login loop after SSO redirect
description: Users are redirected back to the login page after successfully authenticating via SSO. Started shortly after the identity provider certificate rotation.

title: Elevated 4xx rate on billing-api
description: Error rate dashboards show a spike in 400 responses on the /invoices endpoint, correlated with a client-side SDK release earlier today.

title: VPN throughput degraded during peak hours
description: Users report significantly slower VPN speeds between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. No packet loss observed, latency roughly doubled.

title: web-prod-cluster-03 disk usage above 90%
description: Monitoring alert fired for disk utilization on two nodes in the cluster. Log rotation appears to be misconfigured, retaining more history than expected.

title: Backup restore test failed for hr-portal database
description: Quarterly restore drill for the hr-portal database failed validation — restored row counts did not match the source snapshot.
